The rune is attached to a blunt weapon (any non-edged weapon), which is then capable of causing an earthshattering shock
Rule details
Makes a blunt weapon release an earth-shattering shock when it strikes.
whenever the Thuul attacks. Any victim struck by this shock is paralyzed by the force and incapable of acting. This rune is always active but must still have the requisite number of Divinity Points linked to it.
